selection: For each aligned-vs-mixed pair, retain candidates meeting accuracy floor and overall/per-context gaps. Maximize minimum overall accuracy, then minimize overall gap, then prefer smaller aligned epoch and smaller mixed epoch. No IIA used. Report unmatched pairs; do not relax criteria.
training: Each epoch candidate retrains from identical initialization with the pilot Adam implementation, lr .01, batch 128, training RNG seed +10000. Fixed 132 parameters. No optimizer restarts within candidate.
mapping: After pair selection, choose one of two branches on independent mapping data and donors using existing mapping algorithm.
primary: All validation-selected pairs: held-out overall and context accuracy gaps and memory IIA differences, plus whether the same matching tolerances transfer. Never drop pairs based on test performance.
secondary: IIA on one shared subset where both models predict the factual input and explicit memory-input replacement counterfactual correctly. Report subset size and changed-case subset size; null for empty groups. This is a selection-biased diagnostic, not a causal adjustment.
limitations: Engineered task/masks; validation matching is approximate; fixed small checkpoint grid can fail; training duration differs; accuracy equality does not imply equal error structure; no biological inference. No formal confirmatory significance test.
publication: Publish protocol hash, all candidate validation scores, locked selections, all selected-pair test results, summaries and source/data hashes. No post-hoc protocol revisions based on test outcomes.
